build_QFunction_MLP: build a QFunction MLP model with observation and action dimensions for the critic
build_Critic_component: build a Critic component with two Q-functions and an encoder for SAC agents
create_QFunction_head: create a FeedForward head for the Q-function using mixture of experts
create_Critic_encoder: create an encoder for the Critic to process multi-task observations
run_Critic_forward: run the Critic forward pass to compute Q1 and Q2 values for given observations and actions
